title: E1 fix round 1 (v2): security_paths cover the MCP surface, prompts and skills; NUL-safe diff; real git tests; empty list fails closed (from review T-0221)
spec:
Fix round on task/T-0220 (commit d8531a3, which sits on goal/T-0201 head 6358799). STEP 0, before anything else: your worktree was cut from goal/T-0201 and lacks that commit. Run `git reset --hard task/T-0220` in the worktree and confirm `git log --oneline -1` shows d8531a3; then work on top of it. Address the opus review T-0221 on orchestrator/daemon.py, .orchestrator/pool.toml and tests/test_daemon.py:
1. pool.toml [review] security_paths adds orchestrator/mcp.py, orchestrator/bus_mcp.py, .orchestrator/prompts/**, skills/**, .claude/skills/**, .mcp.worker.json. Keep orchestrator/jev*.py with a comment that E2 (T-0214) adds the files. Mirror the same list in DEFAULT_SECURITY_PATHS.
2. changed_paths(): run git diff --name-only -z <base>..HEAD and split on NUL so quoted or non-ASCII paths match the globs; still None on any failure.
3. _review_plan(): under code_review="security_paths" an empty or missing security_paths list fails closed: one review with review_reason 'security_paths_empty' and a one-time notify, never a silent "none".
4. Tests over a real temporary git repo (init, commit on a goal/<parent> branch, cut a task branch, commit): a change under .claude/hooks/ matches; a change to a plain source file does not; a path with a space and an umlaut matches through -z; a non-git worktree returns None; empty security_paths yields reviews_expected 1 with review_reason security_paths_empty. Keep the monkeypatched tests as they are.
Out of scope: CLAUDE.md / planner.md / README wording (T-0213 E1b does that after this merges). Commit on your task branch when green.
acceptance: git log on the task branch contains d8531a3 (E1 v2) below the fix commit
pool.toml security_paths contains orchestrator/mcp.py, orchestrator/bus_mcp.py, .orchestrator/prompts/**, skills/**, .claude/skills/**
All tests from T-0220 still pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

All 5 target tests exist and the full run showed `OK` (71/71) earlier. Final check of `tests-green.sh` already confirmed exit 0.

## Summary

Fixed round on T-0220 per the opus review (T-0221), on top of task/T-0220 (d8531a3) as required.

**Files changed:**
- `orchestrator/daemon.py` — `DEFAULT_SECURITY_PATHS` and `changed_paths()`/`_review_plan()` updated
- `.orchestrator/pool.toml` — `[review].security_paths` mirrors the new list
- `tests/test_daemon.py` — new tests

**Changes:**
1. Added `orchestrator/mcp.py`, `orchestrator/bus_mcp.py`, `.orchestrator/prompts/**`, `skills/**`, `.claude/skills/**`, `.mcp.worker.json` to both `DEFAULT_SECURITY_PATHS` and pool.toml's `security_paths`; kept `orchestrator/jev*.py` with a comment noting T-0214 (E2) adds the actual files.
2. `changed_paths()` now runs `git diff --name-only -z <base>..HEAD` and splits on NUL, so quoted/non-ASCII paths still match; still returns `None` on any failure.
3. `_review_plan()` now fails closed on empty/missing `security_paths` under `code_review="security_paths"`: one review, `review_reason="security_paths_empty"`, one-time `notify()`.
4. Added 5 tests using real temporary git repos: hook-path match, plain-source no-match, quoted/umlaut path match via `-z`, non-git worktree → `None`, and empty `security_paths` → fail-closed with 1 review. Kept the existing monkeypatched security_paths tests unchanged.

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_daemon` → `Ran 71 tests ... OK`. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0.

Commit `6005a54` on `task/T-0223`, sitting directly on `d8531a3` (T-0220).
